gate.note: The travelling merchant at the gate (TODO M7). He comes only where a cart can come (minRoad), with `chance` at the end of a question (+ perRoadLevel for each better road level), stays `stay` questions, buys the kinds in `cats` without a trip and without energy at the village price x `cut`, until his cart (base + perRoadLevel x (road level - 1) load units) is full. A new visit starts with an empty cart.
